summary: The exhaustive Q4 walk found no phantom malformed-record recovery contract, no stale offline/model-API/GnuCOBOL requirement, no circular ODO/REDEFINES summary grading, and no undiscoverable verifier-consumed public path. However, two material forward-coverage gaps remain. The --layout override test changes only the layout identifier, so an evaluator can ignore alternate field-binding semantics and still pass. Separately, the public failure contract requires failed records to report a determinable record byte_length, but malformed full-record tests accept any non-negative value, including 0. Both gaps affect documented stable public interfaces, so Q4 is REVISE.

evidence.observation: Q4 must exhaustively inventory requirements and verifier behaviors, complete both mappings, inspect F2P/P2P and stable interfaces, perform a second omission sweep, and block on material untested requirements.
Q4 requires meaningful requirement-to-test coverage, reverse verifier-to-contract discoverability, delegated-contract review, output-interface review, and a second adversarial omission sweep.
Material functional, failure-handling, path, CLI, and structured-output obligations must be solver-visible; referenced technical contracts may carry detailed layout/schema/CLI semantics.

The work request names the evaluator, default layout, default sample records, output path, CLI path overrides, COMP-3 sign classes, REDEFINES, ODO, and record-byte-length behavior by reference to the layout contract.

The delegated contract defines CLI flags/defaults, packed/display storage rules, REDEFINES, ODO/framing, report schema, record-error semantics, and the rule that failed records use byte_length 0 only when the boundary cannot be determined.
The handoff is solver-visible current-state context describing observed unpacker symptoms without naming an internal repair location.
The incident log independently supports the current-state symptoms referenced by the work request/handoff.

Twenty-three behavioral cases cover public/holdout COMP-3 semantics, direct ODO/REDEFINES behavior, CLI defaults/overrides, report schema, malformed records, one P2P preservation case, and rerun stability; the layout override mutates only LAYOUT SKU-REC to LAYOUT SKU-OVERRIDE.
Four malformed COMP-3 cases cover signed/unsigned sign classes, zero pad, and non-decimal digits, but their shared record-error assertion accepts any byte_length >= 0.

findings.criterion: Complete requirement -> verifier coverage for the documented --layout PATH stable CLI interface
findings.why_it_matters: The contract makes the supplied layout path part of evaluator behavior, but the only alternate-layout case copies the default layout and changes only its LAYOUT identifier. A plausible implementation can hard-code the default field widths/types/REDEFINES/ODO schema, read only the first layout line for layout_id, and pass every current layout-override assertion. Therefore the verifier does not prove that alternate layout binding semantics are honored.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add or replace the alternate-layout F2P scenario with a solver-hidden layout and matching record data that changes at least one semantically active binding (for example field width/order/type or ODO structure), then assert decoded fields and/or record byte length derived from that alternate layout. Keep the solver-visible CLI contract unchanged and do not expose the hidden fixture topology.
findings.regression_risk: Verifier-only strengthening may expose implementations that special-case the default layout. Rerun affected deterministic Oracle/NOP and quality freshness gates after the test change.

findings.criterion: Complete requirement -> verifier coverage for the documented failed-record byte_length stable output interface
findings.why_it_matters: The public report contract says a failed record must carry its byte_length when that boundary can be determined from available bytes and layout, using 0 only when it cannot. The indeterminate truncation case correctly asserts 0, but malformed complete-record cases accept any non-negative integer. An implementation that reports byte_length=0 for every malformed record can therefore pass while violating the documented stable report interface.
findings.minimal_remediation: For at least one malformed packed field in an otherwise complete record whose ODO count and boundary remain determinable, assert the layout-derived record byte length. Preserve the current non-prescriptive invalid-ODO recovery contract; do not reintroduce a private exact invalid-ODO length requirement.
findings.regression_risk: This strengthens externally documented failure metadata and may expose parsers that stop before computing a determinable boundary. No solver-visible contract expansion is required.

change_scope: Verifier/tests only: strengthen alternate-layout semantic coverage.
Verifier/tests only: cover documented determinable failed-record byte_length behavior.
do_not_change: Do not weaken or remove the documented --layout PATH override contract.
Do not weaken or remove the documented failed-record byte_length rule.
Do not reintroduce private recovery/continuation requirements or an exact invalid-ODO length.
Do not replace direct ODO/REDEFINES behavioral grading with self-reported summary booleans.
next_gate: QUALITY_INTERLOCK remains REVISE; return to the CI Orchestrator / Submission Controller for verifier-coverage remediation and refreeze.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: Evaluate the named public SKU tape through /app/equiv/bin/equiv-eval using the documented defaults and produce /app/equiv/out/equivalence-report.json.
--records PATH and --out PATH overrides work; unknown flags exit 2 without changing the existing report semantics.
--layout PATH drives evaluator behavior rather than the default layout.
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.NOTE: The alternate file changes only layout_id; field-binding semantics are unchanged.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: COMP-3 byte sizing, nibble order/padding, decimal digits, signed C/D versus unsigned F classes, implied scale, negative sign, and scale-0 string rendering follow the layout contract.
Display PIC X(n) preserves width/space padding and display PIC 9(n) is exposed as integer semantics.
REDEFINES aliases the target bytes and does not advance offset.
OCCURS DEPENDING ON emits exactly the actual count, enforces bounds, does not consume max span for smaller counts, and drives record byte length.
Concatenated records have no RDW and each next record begins at the computed prior record length, preserving tape order.
The documented public sample decodes to the stated packed/display/ODO/REDEFINES values.
Report objects expose the documented layout/source/records/fields/summary interface, tape-order indices, null/non-empty error convention, and record/error counts.
Failed records report the layout-derived byte_length when determinable and 0 only when indeterminate.
REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.NOTE: Indeterminate=0 is covered; determinable malformed full-record lengths are not asserted.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.REQUIREMENT: The named default layout and public sample remain available as the evaluator's default inputs.

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS.DETAIL: Alternate layout field-binding semantics are not meaningfully exercised; only layout_id differs.
The indeterminate=0 branch is covered, but determinable malformed-record byte_length is not asserted.

F2P_P2P_BOUNDARY_REVIEW.F2P_ASSESSMENT: All F2P behaviors map to discoverable solver-visible requirements; REQ-03 and REQ-11 remain only partially covered in the forward direction.
F2P_P2P_BOUNDARY_REVIEW.P2P_ASSESSMENT: The sole P2P case has legitimate ownership because the layout and public sample are named default evaluator inputs and their public semantics are contractually defined. No phantom incident/handoff/documentation preservation grading remains.

SECOND_PASS_NOTES: Malformed-record tests grade report-visible error/byte_length/summary behavior and do not require a private continuation strategy.
No exact invalid-ODO length is graded.
No stale offline-only, model-API, or GnuCOBOL-install requirement appears in the allowed solver-visible contract or verifier behavior.
ODO and REDEFINES correctness are asserted directly from decoded records/byte lengths rather than circular self-reported summary booleans.
Every verifier-consumed public /app input/output path is named in instruction.md or the explicitly referenced layout contract.
The sole remaining --layout weakness is semantic depth: the alternate layout changes only its identifier.
The sole remaining failed-record metadata weakness is the unasserted determinable-byte_length branch.
